browser: Installed Chrome, Windows native UI control
components: Actual imported AnnouncementModal and AnnouncementMediaPreview, actual app CSS, synthetic account/query/dismissal hooks and generated media only
checks: Named native opener and dialog exposed to accessibility
Tab directly reaches opener; Enter opens; Tab reaches Dismiss; Space activates
Escape closes and visible focus returns to opener; named Close also closes
Portaled dialog renders outside transformed parent on phone and wide layouts
Long 320px title wraps; long body scrolls while Close and Dismiss remain reachable
Synthetic pending acknowledgement keeps dialog open with disabled Dismissing label
Synthetic failed acknowledgement retains dialog and visible retry message
Actual generated GIF decodes at320x180; distinct pink/left and orange/right frames observed
Actual generated WebM decodes; native playback reaches2.96 seconds readyState4/errornull
Native Play replays video and changes to Pause; visible time resets to0
Deliberately invalid image source shows named Retry; repeated Retry preserves recoverability
Replacing failed URL while dialog is open restores decoded image
Arrival of newer row while dialog is open preserves original selected title
Successful acknowledgement submits original news ID, closes and retains newer announcement
Failed read shows Retry announcements; Retry restores opener
Fixture account switch retires open prior-account dialog and mounts next account view
limitations: Synthetic interface transport is separate from the actual28local FirebaseSDK checks; not a live combined authenticated flow.
No real production dismissal, announcement, notification, account, provider action or physical device test.
Native screenshot/accessibility updates sometimes lag one observation; final states were refreshed before claims.
scope: Actual presentation/keyboard/media verification of the changed source. Not certification of full-app or physical native performance.
